updates.note: Reiterated smartphone camera modules volume target of 190-200 million units per annum.
updates.quote: expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.

updates.note: Reiterated IT hardware revenues around INR 3,500 crores to INR 4,000 crores for next year.
updates.quote: we feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

new_promises.statement: IT hardware revenue for FY26 is expected in the range of INR 1,500 crores.
new_promises.quote: So this year, we feel the revenue should be in the range of INR1,500-odd crores.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Total capex outgo for FY26 should be between INR 1,100 crores to INR 1,200 crores.
new_promises.quote: it should be somewhere between INR1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Front-loading washing machine mass production to start by Q2 FY27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
new_promises.quote: mass production to start by Q2 financial year '26-'27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall
